name: Admin Accounting Cuentas de Cobro Center
description: Superuser manages all cuentas de cobro at /panel/accounting/collections (tab renamed from Cobros): status counters (emitidas/pagadas/vencidas/anuladas with totals), segmented status filter, table with numero/origen (hosting/proyecto/ingreso/otro)/cliente/total/emision/vence/estado (Vencida tint via is_overdue) and row actions: view linked income, download PDF, resend to client, mark paid (expected-linked accounts route through the Liquidar modal instead of a plain confirm), cancel (cancelling a hosting-linked account resumes its expiry notices; cancelling frees the linked income for a new cuenta). Since Aug 2026 Cliente and Proyecto are separate sortable, filterable columns and the row opens admin-accounting-collection-detail. Since Aug 2026 a cuenta issued with a zero-day payment term carries no due date at all: the Vence column stays empty and the row can never read as Vencida nor fall into that tab, because is_overdue derives from a date that no longer exists. Since Aug 2026 the row also offers eliminar, which is not anular: it removes the record physically and only appears when the backend says can_delete — the cuenta is already anulada, or it never reached the client (borrador, or emitida whose email failed). A pagada can be neither anulada nor eliminada. The confirmation names consecutivo, cliente and monto and demands the word ELIMINAR, because the delete is irreversible; the consecutivo is not reused (the series keeps a hole) and the linked income goes back to being billable. Every deletion leaves a DELETED row in the accounting historial naming the consecutivo that is gone. Since F7 (Aug 2026) the Proyecto column answers with the LIVE project relation (the FK the filter already matches on) and the frozen customer_project_name snapshot only fills FK-null legacy rows, so the cell and the project filter can never disagree; two cuentas of one client can honestly differ (one linked, one blank — the reported evidence case) and a reload tells the same truth. The frozen snapshot stays the PDF's truth, untouched. Classic and grouped rows now share one 44×44 leading three-dots action that opens CollectionActionsModal (first entry Detalle e historial; the internal notes open in the shared note dialog with its privacy hint), so no command is clipped at the trailing edge; compact columns fit 412 px without an inner horizontal scroll, while status, origin and unlinked-state badges stay atomic.
